[BBC Business] Simon Jack: Can Anthropic's record-breaking IPO stop the AI bubble bursting?
Anthropic's hotly anticipated IPO is expected to put it in the top 10 most valuable US companies, but the future is uncertain.

[BBC Business] The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires
The AI company behind Claude is about to sell its shares on the US stock market - making its founders very rich.

[BBC Business] McDonald's sex abuse: 'They were waiting for the younger girls to turn 18'
A former McDonald's worker calls on the firm to “change the way they treat younger employees” as a judge rules a legal case against the chain can go ahead.

[BBC Business] Viagogo may have broken law on hidden fees, watchdog provisionally finds
The UK's competition body says initial findings suggest the ticket-reselling website used drip pricing.

[CNBC] AMD dives on short-seller report of alleged China exposure
AMD was slumping after a short-seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. The company said it complies with U.S. law.

[CNBC] Kash Patel skips House hearing after Mar-a-Lago gala with $50,000 access
Kash Patel missed a congressional hearing after appearing the night before at a Mar-a-Lago gala offering donors of $50,000 access to top officials.

[CNBC] Commerce approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, Rep. Mast says
Members of Congress have pushed in the wake of the Jensen Huang scandal for legislation to tighten export controls on chip sales to China.

[CNBC] Congress passes bill to protect older investors from financial fraud
Both chambers of Congress have now approved the Financial Exploitation Prevention Act of 2025, which is aimed at protecting vulnerable investors from fraud.

[MarketWatch] ‘I felt so seen’: Why families across America are laughing — and crying — over SNL’s ‘Sister’ sketch
The late-night comedy sketch does the impossible by making female caregivers feel seen.

[MarketWatch] Rising healthcare costs push Medicare Part B premiums higher
The premiums will increase by $6.50, to $209.40 a month.

[MarketWatch] ‘Nvidia’s turmoil has me spooked’: Should I sell my stocks and buy real estate — or ride out the storm?
Tempted to ditch stocks for property or CDs? Take a deep breath before making any sudden moves.

[MarketWatch] Nvidia’s stock falls further. It has lost $611 billion in six trading days.
There are only 23 companies in the world with a market capitalization of $611 billion or higher
